label: title
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the major titles the club won from the mid-1980s to the end of the 2000s (titles won in the same season may be listed in any order).
criterion: a major title won by the club: a league championship or a European or intercontinental competition title (including a final win)
why_needs_multiple: Tám danh hiệu lớn trong một giai đoạn; cần đủ cả tám, các mốc cùng mùa giải ghi 'in any order'.

label: title
question: Among the major titles recorded in the timeline from the mid-1980s to the end of the 2000s, which one was won immediately after the Saporta Cup final against PAOK?
criterion: a major title won by the club: a league championship or a European or intercontinental competition title (including a final win)
why_needs_multiple: Cần biết danh hiệu kế tiếp trong chuỗi các danh hiệu lớn của giai đoạn, nên phải xét cả chuỗi.

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the appointments of head coaches from the early 1950s to the mid-1970s.
criterion: a dated event in which a person is appointed head coach of the basketball team (begins a head-coach tenure)
why_needs_multiple: Tám lần bổ nhiệm huấn luyện viên trưởng; chỉ lấy mốc bắt đầu, không lấy mốc kết thúc tenure.

question: How many years passed between Pedro Ferrándiz's first appointment as head coach and his third appointment as head coach?
criterion: Pedro Ferrándiz's first and third appointments as head coach
why_needs_multiple: Hai lần bổ nhiệm của cùng một người được nêu tên; câu hỏi khoảng cách giữa hai mốc.

label: home_arena
question: List, in chronological order, the dated events since the 1980s in which a venue began to serve as the club's home arena, temporary home arenas included.
criterion: a venue begins to be used as the club's home arena, including a temporary one
why_needs_multiple: Sáu lần một địa điểm bắt đầu là sân nhà; cần đủ cả sáu để liệt kê đúng.

label: sponsor_name
question: List, in chronological order, the dated events in which a new sponsor name began to appear in the club's team name.
criterion: the start of a period in which a new sponsor name is added to the club's team name
why_needs_multiple: Ba tên tài trợ bắt đầu xuất hiện; mỗi tên chỉ lấy mốc bắt đầu.
